content_of_post_to_comment: In an essay a couple of years ago I argued that the metacrisis, and all the chaos in the world, is predictable when you look at historical socio-cultural, economic and similar long wave cycles. Now I am starting to think chaos and collapse is the result of a moral mistake. That mistake is to confuse what is good with what can be measured, used, produced, consumed. Unfortunately we—human persons—get caught up in that. We get measured, used, produced, consumed. Is the solution a moral renaissance?
